videos.title: Congress Presses Nvidia Over China Chip Access
videos.description: Democratic Rep. Raja Krishnamoorthi is on Bloomberg This Weekend to discuss the national security questions surrounding former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, including what Huang knew about alleged Chinese intelligence activity and whether restricted Nvidia chips reached entities in China. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Krishnamoorthi calls for stronger export controls and congressional oversight while raising questions about Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick’s handling of Nvidia and Megaspeed. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: AI Investors Brace for Data Center Restrictions
videos.description: PIMCO market strategist Tony Crescenzi is on Bloomberg This Weekend to assess what growing political resistance to data centers could mean for the AI investment boom, arguing that new restrictions may slow construction without derailing the broader buildout. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Crescenzi also discusses the fallout surrounding Nvidia, the outlook for the US economy and why higher yields are creating opportunities for investors in high-quality corporate bonds. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video?
